videoDetails.title: AMR Overtures Roundtable on the Danvers Statement
videoDetails.shortDescription:
Should the PCA declare the Danvers Statement to be biblically faithful?

In this conversation, David Coffin, Steve Tipton, and Howie Donahoe, and Derek Radney discuss Overture 61, regarding the Danvers Statement. This excerpt from the larger overtures discussion explores questions of principle, authority, and the practical implications of adopting statements that extend beyond the church's constitutional standards.

Watch the rest of the interview here: https://a4mr.substack.com/publish/post/199782769
